<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
I have reviewed the plan and existing code. I am now implementing task T04.

T04 covers three endpoints: POST /api/tickets, GET /api/tickets, and GET /api/tickets/{id}. The list endpoint returns paginated results without search or filtering. The detail endpoint returns an empty comments array. Basic input validation is required now, while full Bean Validation is deferred to T09. A 404 response for unknown IDs is noted as a gap until T10.

I will add the Spring Boot validation starter and apply basic annotations now. This satisfies the hard rule for backend input validation without overlapping T09's full coverage.

I confirmed that `spring-boot-starter-validation` must be added explicitly because Spring Boot 4 does not include it transitively. Local CORS support is also being considered. The T04 implementation will cover a controller, request and response DTOs, a service layer, and repository paging.

Concrete DTOs are planned: CreateTicketRequest, TicketSummaryResponse, TicketDetailResponse, and PageResponse. A custom NotFoundException will throw ResponseStatusException for missing tickets, deferring raw 404s to T10. The create endpoint will reject client-supplied status values with a 400 error per the API contract.

The CreateTicketRequest DTO will use `@NotBlank`, `@Size`, and `TicketPriority` annotations. A `status` field will be included so the endpoint can explicitly reject client-supplied values with a 400 error. Using `@JsonIgnoreProperties` was rejected because it would silently ignore the field instead of failing.

Blank assignee values will be treated as null. Priority defaults to MEDIUM when omitted. The list endpoint will use pagination with page and size parameters, sorted by createdAt descending. Search, filter, and patch operations remain deferred to T08. Sort whitelist and size maximum validation are also reserved for T08.

I will enforce a size cap of 100 on the list endpoint as part of the basic contract. I am also checking for existing package-info files and CORS configuration.
</details></think>

**T04 complete:** create, list, and get ticket APIs are in place and verified with curl.

### What shipped
- `POST /api/tickets` → `201` + `Location` + status always `OPEN` (client `status` rejected)
- `GET /api/tickets` → paged envelope, default `createdAt,desc`, `size` capped at 100
- `GET /api/tickets/{id}` → detail with `comments: []` (comments deferred to T07)
- Local-profile CORS for `http://localhost:3000`

### Files changed
| File | Role |
|------|------|
| `backend/src/main/java/.../api/TicketController.java` | REST endpoints |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../api/CreateTicketRequest.java` | Create DTO + Bean Validation |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../api/TicketSummaryResponse.java` | List item DTO |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../api/TicketDetailResponse.java` | Detail DTO |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../api/CommentResponse.java` | Comment shape (unused until T07) |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../api/PagedTicketsResponse.java` | Page envelope |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../application/TicketService.java` | Create / list / get use cases |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../application/TicketMapper.java` | Entity → DTO |
| `backend/src/main/java/.../config/LocalCorsConfig.java` | Local-only CORS |
| `backend/src/main/resources/application-local.yml` | CORS origin placeholder |
| `backend/pom.xml` | `spring-boot-starter-validation` |
| `spec/plan.md` | T04 marked complete |

### Requirement mapping
| Req | Coverage in T04 |
|-----|-----------------|
| FR1 Create | `POST /api/tickets` |
| FR2 List | `GET /api/tickets` (paging; no `q`/`status` yet → T08) |
| FR3 Detail | `GET /api/tickets/{id}` (comments empty until T07) |
| FR9 Validation | Blank title/description rejected; create rejects client `status` |
| FR10 Errors | HTTP 4xx returned; **stable error JSON (`code`/`message`/`details`) deferred to T10** |

### Spec notes / known gaps (not invented)
1. **Error body incomplete until T10** — Spring default 400/404 bodies lack `code`, `message`, `details` from the contract.
2. **Malformed UUID** — still Spring type-mismatch (raw 400), not contract-shaped `VALIDATION_ERROR`.
3. **`data-model.md` open questions** (priority enum, max lengths, ID type) are already locked in `api-contract.md`; the data-model “Open questions” section is stale.
4. **Search/filter/sort whitelist** — intentionally out of T04 (T08).
5. **`api-contract.md` line 3** still says state-machine “not yet written” while `spec/state-machine.md` exists.

Next backend task: **T05** (`PATCH` fields + assignee).
